description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Dark/Fire, grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Seifer (Dark, Fire)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Seifer (Dark, Fire)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire or Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Seifer (Fire, Dark) after using three Fire or Dark abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Bloodfest+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Demon Slice+
description.text: Four single attacks (? each), grants [Buff Fire 10% (5s)] and [Buff Dark 10% (5s)] to all allies every third activation

description.name: Spirit Attack: Seifer (Fire, Dark)
description.text: Grants [100% critical 2], [Critical Damage +50% 2] and [Dark/Fire Ability Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
